description.value: Sushi Tendo is a Japanese sushi restaurant on Cambie Street in Vancouver's Cambie Village neighbourhood, offering indoor-only seating with no outdoor patio. The restaurant supports online ordering with a pickup discount, making it a practical stop for cyclists wanting a sit-down or takeout Japanese meal along this busy commercial corridor.
